title: Way Overpriced
text:
Way Overpriced. This clothing rack is way, way, way overpriced. I paid $150 for this. I would have been happy to pay it if it truly was as great as the description made it appear.

The rack is not as easy to fold back up as they state. The middle rack does not easily slide up and down, and you have to slide it all the way up to fold the rack. One end of the middle pole often gets stuck while trying to raise it back up. I wish they gave the option to just remove the middle pole for those who would never need to use it, but the middle pole cannot be removed. I think it's a pain to have to lower and raise it every time you wanna unfold and fold the rack.

To charge $150 for the materials used is outrageous, in my opinion Also, the rack is only 50 inches high when set up, so any bedding over 100 inches is gonna touch the ground. The instructions that come with it are completely in a foreign language.
